items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Ed Durham... Basically, which ones really sort of influenced you and in what way?

ctx.x: a soprano only it had a slide on it. It had the mouthpiece and the reed and everything.

Quent, that's -- Now, we've mentioned, Butter, we've mentioned here -- naturally, being a trombonist, you will join [ ] J, Vic Dickerson, Teagarden, Big Green, J. C. Higgenbotham, Claude Jones, Jimmy Harrison, Keg Johnson, Tyree Glenn, DePriest Wheeler, Lawrence Brown, Trummy Young. We just got through with Sandy Williams and Snub Moseley.

Now, if you -- just personally, who do you think was the most impressive in that whole thing? Which ones of these, if you can just offhand right off the top of your head, impressed you mostly as really -- We mentioned Dickie Wells -- all had different styles -- Dickie Wells and all these different -- Ed Durham, J. J. Johnson, Urkle Herbie Green, Bill Watrous, Carl Fontana. Basically, which ones really sort of influenced you and in what way?
